decisions.reason: The Psalm puts "at the hearing of the ear they obey me" first, the reverse of 2 Samuel 22:45; "сыны чужбины" (L) and "чужеземцы" (B) as there.

decisions.choice: bene nekhar "異国の子ら" (L), "外国の人々" (B, R), as 2 Samuel 22:45
decisions.reason: Foreigners (m2).

source.text: בְּנֵי־נֵכָ֥ר יִבֹּ֑לוּ וְ֝יַחְרְג֗וּ מִֽמִּסְגְּרֽוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Sons of foreignness wither, and come trembling from their strongholds.

en.L: Sons of foreign lands wither, and they come trembling out of their strongholds.
en.B: Foreigners lose heart; they come out of their fortresses shaking.
en.R: They lose their courage. They come out of their hiding places, shaking with fear.

fr.L: Les fils de l’étranger se fanent, et ils sortent en tremblant de leurs forteresses.
fr.B: Les étrangers perdent courage ; ils sortent de leurs forteresses en tremblant.
fr.R: Ils perdent courage. Ils sortent de leurs cachettes en tremblant de peur.

sw.L: Wana wa nchi za kigeni wanadhoofika, nao wanatoka wakitetemeka katika ngome zao.
sw.B: Wageni wanakata tamaa; wanatoka katika ngome zao wakitetemeka.
sw.R: Wanakosa ujasiri. Wanatoka katika maficho yao, wakitetemeka kwa hofu.

es.L: Los hijos de tierras extranjeras se marchitan, y salen temblando de sus fortalezas.
es.B: Los extranjeros pierden el ánimo; salen temblando de sus fortalezas.
es.R: Pierden el valor. Salen de sus escondites temblando de miedo.

vi.L: Con cái của các xứ ngoại bang héo hon, và chúng run rẩy ra khỏi đồn lũy của chúng.
vi.B: Người ngoại quốc mất hết can đảm; họ run rẩy bước ra khỏi đồn lũy của mình.
vi.R: Họ mất hết can đảm. Họ ra khỏi nơi ẩn nấp, run lên vì sợ.

ko.L: 이방의 아들들이 시들어, 그들의 요새에서 떨며 나옵니다.
ko.B: 이방 사람들은 기가 꺾여 자기들의 요새에서 떨며 나옵니다.
ko.R: 그들은 용기를 잃었습니다. 그들은 숨어 있던 곳에서 두려워 떨며 나옵니다.

pt.L: Filhos de terras estrangeiras murcham, e saem tremendo das suas fortalezas.
pt.B: Os estrangeiros perdem o ânimo; eles saem tremendo das suas fortalezas.
pt.R: Eles perdem a coragem. Eles saem dos seus esconderijos tremendo de medo.

am.L: የባዕድ ልጆች ይጠወልጋሉ፤ ከምሽጎቻቸውም እየተንቀጠቀጡ ይወጣሉ።
am.B: ባዕዳን ልባቸው ይዝላል፤ እየተንቀጠቀጡ ከምሽጎቻቸው ይወጣሉ።
am.R: ድፍረታቸውን ያጣሉ። በፍርሃት እየተንቀጠቀጡ ከተደበቁበት ይወጣሉ።

hi.L: परदेश के पुत्र मुरझा जाते हैं, और अपने गढ़ों में से काँपते हुए निकलते हैं।
hi.B: परदेशियों का साहस टूट जाता है; वे काँपते हुए अपने गढ़ों से निकल आते हैं।
hi.R: उनका साहस टूट जाता है। वे डर से काँपते हुए अपने छिपने के स्थानों से निकल आते हैं।

ru.L: Сыны чужбины увядают и, дрожа, выходят из своих крепостей.
ru.B: Чужеземцы падают духом, они выходят из своих крепостей, дрожа.
ru.R: Они теряют мужество. Они выходят из своих укрытий, дрожа от страха.

ja.L: 異国の子らは、しおれ、震えながら彼らの砦から出て来る。
ja.B: 外国の人々は気力を失い、震えながら、その砦から出て来る。
ja.R: 彼らは勇気をなくしてしまう。こわくて震えながら、隠れていた所から出て来る。

uk.L: Сини чужих земель никнуть, і вони виходять, тремтячи, зі своїх твердинь.
uk.B: Чужинці падають духом; вони виходять зі своїх фортець, тремтячи.
uk.R: Вони втрачають відвагу. Вони виходять зі своїх схованок, тремтячи від страху.

decisions.choice: come trembling: rare verb
decisions.reason: The verb (charag) is found only here; a related word suggests trembling (compare Micah 7:17). 2 Samuel 22:46 has a different verb, possibly "they limp out" or "they gird themselves".

decisions.choice: wither: lose heart
decisions.reason: Like a plant drying up, their courage fails (Exodus 18:18 uses the same verb).

decisions.choice: "እየተንቀጠቀጡ ይወጣሉ" (they come out trembling) where 2 Samuel 22:46 has "they gird themselves"
decisions.reason: The two Hebrew verbs differ in the order of two letters.

decisions.choice: "काँपते हुए निकलते हैं"
decisions.reason: The Psalm has "they come trembling" where 2 Samuel 22:46 has "they gird themselves"; the rest keeps the 2 Samuel wording.

decisions.choice: "дрожа, выходят"
decisions.reason: The Psalm's rare verb charag most likely means to come out trembling (m1), where 2 Samuel 22:46 has "they gird themselves" ("опоясываются").

source.text: חַי־יְ֭הוָה וּבָר֣וּךְ צוּרִ֑י וְ֝יָר֗וּם אֱלוֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Living [is] YHWH, and blessed [be] my rock, and may be exalted [the] God of my salvation,

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} lives! And blessed [be] my rock, and may the God of my salvation be exalted,
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is alive! Blessed be my rock! May the God who saves me be lifted high,
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is alive! Praise God, who is my rock! Praise the God who saves me!

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant ! Et béni [soit] mon rocher, et que le Dieu de mon salut soit exalté,
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant ! Béni soit mon rocher ! Que le Dieu qui me sauve soit élevé bien haut,
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant ! Louez Dieu, mon rocher ! Louez le Dieu qui me sauve !

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yu hai! Na mwamba wangu abarikiwe, na Mungu wa wokovu wangu atukuzwe,
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yu hai! Mwamba wangu na abarikiwe! Mungu anayeniokoa na ainuliwe juu,
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yu hai! Msifuni Mungu, aliye mwamba wangu! Msifuni Mungu anayeniokoa!

es.L: ¡Vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}! Y bendita [sea] mi roca, y sea exaltado el Dios de mi salvación,
es.B: ¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} vive! ¡Bendita sea mi roca! Que sea enaltecido el Dios que me salva,
es.R: ¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} está vivo! ¡Alabado sea Dios, que es mi roca! ¡Alabado sea el Dios que me salva!

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống! Và đáng chúc tụng thay vầng đá của tôi, và nguyện Đức Chúa Trời của sự cứu rỗi tôi được tôn cao,
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống! Chúc tụng vầng đá của tôi! Nguyện Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng giải cứu tôi, được tôn cao,
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đang sống! Hãy ca ngợi Đức Chúa Trời, vầng đá của tôi! Hãy ca ngợi Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng cứu tôi!

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계신다! 나의 반석은 송축을 받으시고, 내 구원의 하나님께서 높임을 받으시기를.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계신다! 나의 반석을 송축하여라! 나를 구원하시는 하나님께서 높임을 받으시기를!
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계신다! 나의 반석이신 하나님을 찬양하여라! 나를 구원하시는 하나님을 찬양하여라!

pt.L: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} vive! E bendita [seja] a minha rocha, e seja exaltado o Deus da minha salvação,
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} vive! Bendita seja a minha rocha! Seja exaltado o Deus que me salva,
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} está vivo! Louvado seja Deus, a minha rocha! Louvado seja o Deus que me salva!

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሕያው ነው! ዓለቴም ይባረክ፤ የመዳኔ አምላክም ከፍ ከፍ ይበል፤
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሕያው ነው! ዓለቴ ይባረክ! የሚያድነኝ አምላክ ከፍ ከፍ ይበል፤
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሕያው ነው! ዓለቴ የሆነውን አምላክ አመስግኑ! የሚያድነኝን አምላክ አመስግኑ!

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} जीवित हैं! और मेरी चट्टान धन्य हो, और मेरे उद्धार के परमेश्वर ऊँचे किए जाएँ,
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} जीवित हैं! मेरी चट्टान धन्य हो! मेरा उद्धार करनेवाले परमेश्वर महान माने जाएँ,
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} जीवित हैं! परमेश्वर की स्तुति हो, जो मेरी चट्टान हैं! मुझे बचानेवाले परमेश्वर की स्तुति हो!

ru.L: Жив {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}! И благословенна моя скала, и да будет превознесён Бог моего спасения,
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} жив! Благословенна моя скала! Да будет превознесён Бог, который спасает меня,
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} жив! Хвала Богу, моей скале! Хвала Богу, который спасает меня!

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は生きておられる！わたしの岩はほめたたえられよ。わたしの救いの神はあがめられよ。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は生きておられる！わたしの岩がほめたたえられるように！わたしを救ってくださる神が、高くあがめられるように。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は生きておられる！わたしの岩である神をほめたたえよう！わたしを救ってくださる神をほめたたえよう！

uk.L: Живий {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}! І благословенна моя скеля, і нехай буде звеличений Бог мого спасіння,
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} живий! Благословенна моя скеля! Нехай буде піднесений Бог, що спасає мене,
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} живий! Хваліть Бога, який — моя скеля! Хваліть Бога, який спасає мене!

decisions.choice: The LORD lives: the living God
decisions.reason: The words are used in oaths ("as the LORD lives", 1 Samuel 14:39); here they are a shout of praise. The LORD, unlike idols, is alive and acts (Jeremiah 10:10).

decisions.choice: blessed: praised
decisions.reason: As in 16:7.

decisions.choice: a sentence that runs on
decisions.reason: The praise continues through verse 49, so this verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: "የመዳኔ አምላክ" (the God of my salvation) where 2 Samuel 22:47 has "the God of the rock of my salvation"
decisions.reason: The psalm's Hebrew has no "rock" here.

decisions.choice: "मेरे उद्धार के परमेश्वर"
alternatives: "मेरे उद्धार की चट्टान के परमेश्वर", as 2 Samuel 22:47
decisions.reason: The Psalm has "the God of my salvation" where 2 Samuel 22:47 has "the God of the rock of my salvation"; "धन्य हो" (L, B) and "की स्तुति हो" (R) keep the 2 Samuel wording.

decisions.choice: "Бог моего спасения"
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 22:47 has "the God of the rock of my salvation"; the Psalm has "the God of my salvation". "Благословенна" (L, B) and "Хвала" (R) as there.

decisions.choice: barukh "ほめたたえられよ" (L), "ほめたたえられるように" (B), "ほめたたえよう" (R); 18:47 closes its sentence and 18:48 resumes with "その神は"
decisions.reason: The Psalter's form; the English runs on into 18:48 (m3), which Japanese takes up again with the subject.

source.text: הָאֵ֗ל הַנּוֹתֵ֣ן נְקָמ֣וֹת לִ֑י וַיַּדְבֵּ֖ר עַמִּ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: the God who gives vengeances for me and has subdued peoples under me,

en.L: the God who gives vengeance for me and has subdued peoples under me,
en.B: the God who avenges me and brings nations under my rule,
en.R: God punishes my enemies for me. He makes nations obey me.

fr.L: le Dieu qui me donne vengeance et qui a soumis les peuples sous moi,
fr.B: le Dieu qui me venge et qui place les nations sous mon autorité,
fr.R: Dieu punit mes ennemis pour moi. Il fait que les nations m’obéissent.

sw.L: Mungu anayenilipia kisasi na kuwatiisha watu chini yangu,
sw.B: Mungu anayenilipizia kisasi na kuyaweka mataifa chini ya utawala wangu,
sw.R: Mungu huwaadhibu adui zangu kwa ajili yangu. Huyafanya mataifa yanitii.

es.L: el Dios que me da venganza y ha sometido pueblos debajo de mí,
es.B: el Dios que me venga y pone las naciones bajo mi gobierno,
es.R: Dios castiga a mis enemigos por mí. Él hace que las naciones me obedezcan.

vi.L: là Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng báo thù cho tôi và đã bắt các dân phục dưới tôi,
vi.B: là Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng báo thù cho tôi và đặt các dân tộc dưới quyền tôi,
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời trừng phạt kẻ thù cho tôi. Ngài làm cho các dân tộc vâng phục tôi.

ko.L: 그분은 나를 위해 원수를 갚으시고 민족들을 내 아래 굴복시키신 하나님이시다.
ko.B: 그분은 나를 위해 원수를 갚아 주시고 민족들을 내 다스림 아래 두시는 하나님이시다.
ko.R: 하나님께서는 나를 위해 내 원수들을 벌하신다. 민족들이 나에게 복종하게 하신다.

pt.L: o Deus que me dá vingança e submeteu povos debaixo de mim,
pt.B: o Deus que me vinga e põe as nações debaixo do meu domínio,
pt.R: Deus castiga os meus inimigos por mim. Ele faz as nações me obedecerem.

am.L: ለእኔ በቀልን የሚሰጥ፣ ሕዝቦችንም ከበታቼ ያስገዛ አምላክ፣
am.B: የሚበቀልልኝ አምላክ፣ ሕዝቦችንም ከአገዛዜ በታች የሚያደርግ፣
am.R: እግዚአብሔር ጠላቶቼን ይቀጣልኛል። ሕዝቦችንም እንዲታዘዙኝ ያደርጋል።

hi.L: वह परमेश्वर जो मेरे लिए पलटा लेते हैं, और जिन्होंने देश-देश के लोगों को मेरे अधीन कर दिया है,
hi.B: वह परमेश्वर जो मेरा पलटा लेते हैं और देशों को मेरे अधीन करते हैं,
hi.R: परमेश्वर मेरे लिए मेरे शत्रुओं को दंड देते हैं। वे देशों से मेरी आज्ञा मनवाते हैं।

ru.L: Бог, который совершает за меня отмщение и покорил подо мной народы,
ru.B: Бог, который мстит за меня и подчиняет мне народы,
ru.R: Бог наказывает моих врагов за меня. Он делает так, что народы подчиняются мне.

ja.L: その神は、わたしのために報復をし、もろもろの民をわたしの下に従わせられた。
ja.B: その神は、わたしのために報復し、もろもろの民を、わたしの支配に服させてくださる。
ja.R: 神は、わたしのために、敵を罰してくださる。国々を、わたしに従わせてくださる。

uk.L: Бог, що дає помсту за мене і підкорив піді мною народи,
uk.B: Бог, що мститься за мене й підкоряє народи моїй владі,
uk.R: Бог карає моїх ворогів замість мене. Він робить так, що народи коряться мені.

decisions.choice: vengeance: God's just punishment
decisions.reason: Vengeance (neqamah) belongs to God (Deuteronomy 32:35). David does not take it for himself; God gives it, setting right the wrong done to him.

decisions.choice: subdued: brought under control
decisions.reason: The verb (davar) here means to bring under or subdue (47:4 uses it so).

decisions.choice: "ያስገዛ" (has subdued) where 2 Samuel 22:48 has "brings down"
decisions.reason: The psalm's Hebrew has a different verb.

decisions.choice: "मेरे अधीन कर दिया है"
alternatives: "मेरे नीचे कर देते हैं", as 2 Samuel 22:48
decisions.reason: The Psalm has "has subdued peoples under me" where 2 Samuel 22:48 has "brings down"; "पलटा लेते हैं" keeps the 2 Samuel wording.

decisions.choice: "покорил", "подчиняет"
decisions.reason: The Psalm's verb davar means to subdue (m2), where 2 Samuel 22:48 has "brings down" ("низлагает").

source.text: מְפַלְּטִ֗י מֵאֹ֫יְבָ֥י אַ֣ף מִן־קָ֭מַי תְּרוֹמְמֵ֑נִי מֵאִ֥ישׁ חָ֝מָ֗ס תַּצִּילֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: delivering me from my enemies; indeed, above those who rise against me you exalt me; from a man of violence you rescue me.

en.L: who delivers me from my enemies; indeed, above those who rise against me {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} exalt me; from a man of violence {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} rescue me.
en.B: who saves me from my enemies. You raise me high above my attackers; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} save me from the violent man.
en.R: He saves me from my enemies. You lift me high above people who attack me. You save me from the violent man.

fr.L: qui me délivre de mes ennemis ; oui, au-dessus de ceux qui se dressent contre moi {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’élèves ; de l’homme violent {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me délivres.
fr.B: qui me sauve de mes ennemis. Tu m’élèves bien au-dessus de mes agresseurs ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me sauves de l’homme violent.
fr.R: Il me sauve de mes ennemis. Tu m’élèves bien au-dessus de ceux qui m’attaquent. Tu me sauves de l’homme violent.

sw.L: anayeniokoa kutoka kwa adui zangu; naam, juu ya wale walioniinukia unaniinua; kutoka kwa mtu wa jeuri unaniponya.
sw.B: anayeniokoa kutoka kwa adui zangu. Unaniinua juu ya washambuliaji wangu; unaniokoa kutoka kwa mtu mwenye jeuri.
sw.R: Ananiokoa kutoka kwa adui zangu. Unaniinua juu kuliko watu wanaonishambulia. Unaniokoa kutoka kwa mtu mwenye jeuri.

es.L: que me libra de mis enemigos; sí, sobre los que se levantan contra mí {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me exaltas; del hombre violento {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me rescatas.
es.B: que me salva de mis enemigos. Tú me levantas muy por encima de mis atacantes; {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me salvas del hombre violento.
es.R: Él me salva de mis enemigos. Tú me levantas muy por encima de los que me atacan. Tú me salvas del hombre violento.

vi.L: Đấng giải cứu tôi khỏi các kẻ thù của tôi; thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nâng tôi lên cao hơn những kẻ nổi lên chống tôi; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giải cứu tôi khỏi người hung bạo.
vi.B: Đấng giải cứu tôi khỏi các kẻ thù. Ngài nâng tôi lên cao hơn những kẻ tấn công tôi; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cứu tôi khỏi kẻ hung bạo.
vi.R: Ngài cứu tôi khỏi kẻ thù. Ngài nâng tôi lên cao hơn những kẻ tấn công tôi. Ngài cứu tôi khỏi kẻ hung bạo.

ko.L: 그분은 나를 내 원수들에게서 건지시는 [분이시다]. 참으로 주님께서는 저를 치려고 일어나는 자들 위로 저를 높이시고, 폭력의 사람에게서 저를 건지십니다.
ko.B: 그분은 나를 원수들에게서 구원하시는 분이시다. 주님께서는 저를 공격하는 자들 위로 저를 높이 들어 올리시고, 폭력을 휘두르는 사람에게서 저를 구해 주십니다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 원수들에게서 나를 구원하신다. 주님께서는 저를 공격하는 사람들보다 저를 높이 들어 올리십니다. 폭력을 휘두르는 사람에게서 저를 구해 주십니다.

pt.L: que me liberta dos meus inimigos; sim, acima dos que se levantam contra mim {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me exaltas; de um homem de violência {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me livras.
pt.B: que me salva dos meus inimigos. Tu me levantas bem acima dos que me atacam; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me livras do homem violento.
pt.R: Ele me salva dos meus inimigos. Tu me levantas bem acima das pessoas que me atacam. Tu me livras do homem violento.

am.L: ከጠላቶቼ የሚያድነኝ፤ በእኔ ላይ ከሚነሡትም በላይ በእርግጥ ከፍ ታደርገኛለህ፤ ከዓመፀኛ ሰውም ታድነኛለህ።
am.B: ከጠላቶቼ የሚያድነኝ ነው። ካጠቁኝ በላይ ከፍ ከፍ ታደርገኛለህ፤ ከዓመፀኛውም ሰው ታድነኛለህ።
am.R: ከጠላቶቼ ያድነኛል። ከሚያጠቁኝ ሰዎች በላይ ከፍ ታደርገኛለህ። ከዓመፀኛውም ሰው ታድነኛለህ።

hi.L: जो मुझे मेरे शत्रुओं से छुड़ाते हैं; हाँ, मेरे विरुद्ध उठनेवालों से ऊपर तू मुझे ऊँचा करता है; हिंसक मनुष्य से तू मुझे छुड़ाता है।
hi.B: जो मुझे मेरे शत्रुओं से बचाते हैं। तू मुझे मेरे हमलावरों से ऊपर ऊँचा उठाता है; तू मुझे हिंसक मनुष्य से बचाता है।
hi.R: वे मुझे मेरे शत्रुओं से बचाते हैं। तू मुझे मुझ पर हमला करनेवालों से बहुत ऊपर उठाता है। तू मुझे हिंसक मनुष्य से बचाता है।

ru.L: спасающий меня от моих врагов; да, над восстающими на меня {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} возвышаешь меня; от человека насилия {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} избавляешь меня.
ru.B: который спасает меня от моих врагов. Ты возносишь меня над теми, кто нападает на меня, {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} спасаешь меня от жестокого человека.
ru.R: Он спасает меня от моих врагов. Ты поднимаешь меня высоко над теми, кто нападает на меня. Ты спасаешь меня от жестокого человека.

ja.L: わたしを敵から助け出される方。まことに、わたしに立ち向かう者たちよりも高く、あなたはわたしを上げ、暴虐の人から、わたしを救い出される。
ja.B: その方は、わたしを敵から救ってくださる。あなたは、わたしを襲う者たちよりも高く、わたしを上げ、暴虐を行う者から、わたしを救い出してくださる。
ja.R: その方は、敵からわたしを救ってくださる。あなたは、わたしを襲う人々よりも高く、わたしを上げてくださる。乱暴な人から、わたしを救ってくださる。

uk.L: що визволяє мене від моїх ворогів; так, над тими, хто повстає на мене, {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} підносиш мене; від чоловіка насильства {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} рятуєш мене.
uk.B: що рятує мене від моїх ворогів. Ти підносиш мене високо над моїми нападниками; {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} рятуєш мене від чоловіка насильства.
uk.R: Він рятує мене від моїх ворогів. Ти підносиш мене високо над людьми, які нападають на мене. Ти рятуєш мене від жорстокого чоловіка.

decisions.choice: a man of violence: perhaps Saul
decisions.reason: The singular may point to one enemy, Saul (verse 1), or stand for every violent enemy (140:2, 5).

decisions.choice: you exalt me: from "he" to "you"
decisions.reason: As in verse 29, the song turns from speaking of God to speaking to him.

decisions.choice: "Ngài" for both "he" and "you" in this verse
decisions.reason: The English moves from "he" to "you" in mid-verse (see the meaning decision); Vietnamese uses "Ngài" for both, so the turn to speak to God is not marked by the pronoun, as in Psalm 23:4.

decisions.choice: The verse changes from "나" (plain style) to "저" (합쇼체) where the Hebrew changes from "he" to "you"
alternatives: 합쇼체 with 저 for the whole verse
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns to address God in the middle of the verse (meaning decision m2); Korean marks the turn in the same place, as the English does with "You".

decisions.choice: "የሚያድነኝ" (who delivers me) and "በእርግጥ" (indeed), where 2 Samuel 22:49 has "who brings me out"
decisions.reason: The psalm's Hebrew differs.
The Psalm has "delivering me" and "indeed" where 2 Samuel 22:49 has "bringing me out" and "and"; the second half, which speaks to God, keeps the 2 Samuel wording.

decisions.choice: "спасающий меня от моих врагов"
decisions.reason: The Psalm reads "delivering me from my enemies" where 2 Samuel 22:49 reads "bringing me out from my enemies"; the rest keeps the Russian of 2 Samuel.

source.text: עַל־כֵּ֤ן׀אוֹדְךָ֖ בַגּוֹיִ֥ם׀יְהוָ֑ה וּלְשִׁמְךָ֥ אֲזַמֵּֽרָה׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore I will thank you among the nations, YHWH, and to your name I will sing praises.

en.L: Therefore I will thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} among the nations, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, and to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name I will sing praises.
en.B: That is why I will give {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} thanks among the nations, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, and sing praise to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name.
en.R: So, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, I will thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} in front of people from every nation. I will sing praises to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rendrai grâce parmi les nations, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et je chanterai {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom.
fr.B: Voilà pourquoi je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rendrai grâce parmi les nations, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et je chanterai la louange de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom.
fr.R: Alors, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} remercierai devant des gens de toutes les nations. Je chanterai {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} louanges.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo nitakushukuru kati ya mataifa, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} nitaimba sifa.
sw.B: Ndiyo maana nitakushukuru kati ya mataifa, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na kuliimbia sifa jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitakushukuru mbele ya watu wa kila taifa. Nitakuimbia {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} sifa.

es.L: Por tanto {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} daré gracias entre las naciones, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre cantaré alabanzas.
es.B: Por eso {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} daré gracias entre las naciones, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y cantaré alabanzas a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre.
es.R: Así que, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} daré gracias delante de gente de todas las naciones. Cantaré alabanzas para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

vi.L: Vì vậy tôi sẽ cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giữa các dân tộc, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và tôi sẽ ca ngợi danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Vì thế tôi sẽ cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giữa các dân tộc, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và hát ca ngợi danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Vậy, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tôi sẽ cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trước mặt người của mọi dân tộc. Tôi sẽ hát ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그러므로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제가 민족들 가운데서 주님께 감사하고, 주님의 이름을 찬양하겠습니다.
ko.B: 그래서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제가 민족들 가운데서 주님께 감사를 드리고 주님의 이름을 노래하며 찬양하겠습니다.
ko.R: 그러니 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저는 모든 민족의 사람들 앞에서 주님께 감사드리겠습니다. 주님께 찬양을 부르겠습니다.

pt.L: Por isso eu {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} darei graças entre as nações, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, e ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome cantarei louvores.
pt.B: Por isso eu {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} darei graças entre as nações, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, e cantarei louvores ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome.
pt.R: Por isso, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, eu {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} agradecerei diante de gente de todas as nações. Cantarei louvores a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

am.L: ስለዚህ በአሕዛብ መካከል አመሰግንሃለሁ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፤ ለስምህም እዘምራለሁ።
am.B: ስለዚህ በአሕዛብ መካከል አመሰግንሃለሁ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፤ ለስምህም የምስጋና መዝሙር እዘምራለሁ።
am.R: ስለዚህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ በሕዝቦች ሁሉ መካከል አመሰግንሃለሁ፤ ለአንተም የምስጋና መዝሙር እዘምራለሁ።

hi.L: इस कारण, हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मैं जातियों में तेरा धन्यवाद करूँगा, और तेरे नाम का भजन गाऊँगा।
hi.B: इसी कारण, हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मैं जातियों के बीच तेरा धन्यवाद करूँगा और तेरे नाम का भजन गाऊँगा।
hi.R: इसलिए, हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मैं सब देशों के लोगों के सामने तेरा धन्यवाद करूँगा। मैं तेरा भजन गाऊँगा।

ru.L: Поэтому буду прославлять {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} среди народов, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, и {{deity_pronoun:твоему|Твоему}} имени буду петь.
ru.B: Вот почему буду славить {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} среди народов, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, и петь хвалу {{deity_pronoun:твоему|Твоему}} имени.
ru.R: Поэтому, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, я буду славить {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} перед людьми из всех народов. Я буду петь {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} хвалу.

ja.L: それゆえ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしは諸国の中であなたをたたえ、あなたの名にほめ歌を歌う。
ja.B: それゆえ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしは諸国の民の中で、あなたに感謝をささげ、あなたの名をほめ歌う。
ja.R: だから、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしは、あらゆる国の人々の前で、あなたに感謝する。あなたをほめ歌う。

uk.L: Тому я дякуватиму {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}} серед народів, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, і {{deity_pronoun:твоєму|Твоєму}} імені співатиму хвалу.
uk.B: Ось чому я дякуватиму {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}} серед народів, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, і співатиму хвалу {{deity_pronoun:твоєму|Твоєму}} імені.
uk.R: Тож, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, я дякуватиму {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}} перед людьми з усіх народів. Я співатиму хвалу {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}}.

decisions.choice: among the nations: quoted in Romans 15:9
decisions.reason: Paul quotes this line to show that Scripture foresaw people of every nation praising God through Christ (Romans 15:9).

decisions.choice: your name: God himself as he has made himself known
decisions.reason: As in 5:12 and 9:3.

decisions.choice: Por isso ... entre as nações ... cantarei louvores ao teu nome
decisions.reason: Paul quotes this line in Romans 15:9 (m1). As in 2 Samuel 22:50, the Portuguese keeps the words of Romans 15:9 where the Hebrew allows ("Por isso", "entre as nações", "cantarei louvores ao teu nome"), with "darei graças" for the Hebrew "thank" where Romans has "louvarei". The psalm's order, "entre as nações, SENHOR", follows the Hebrew, which here matches Romans more closely than 2 Samuel does.

decisions.choice: The wording of Romans 15:9 and 2 Samuel 22:50: "ስለዚህ በአሕዛብ መካከል አመሰግንሃለሁ ... ለስምህም እዘምራለሁ" (L; B "የምስጋና መዝሙር እዘምራለሁ"), with the divine name after "among the nations", as the psalm's Hebrew orders it
decisions.reason: Romans 15:9 quotes the verse from the Greek, which agrees with the Hebrew apart from leaving out the name; Readable says "በሕዝቦች", as Romans and Samuel do.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Samuel 22:50, which keeps "तेरे नाम का भजन गाऊँगा" from Romans 15:9
decisions.reason: Paul quotes this verse in Romans 15:9. The Hebrew is the same as 2 Samuel 22:50 (only the order of "LORD" and "among the nations" differs), so the 2 Samuel wording is kept; its second line is Romans 15:9's at each level, and "धन्यवाद करूँगा" follows the Hebrew "thank" where Romans has "praise" from the Greek.

decisions.choice: the wording of Romans 15:9
decisions.reason: Paul quotes this line in Romans 15:9 (m1); the Russian keeps that verse's wording ("буду прославлять тебя ... среди народов", "петь хвалу твоему имени"), as 2 Samuel 22:50 does, in the Psalm's order with "among the nations" before "LORD".

decisions.choice: "あなたをたたえ…ほめ歌を歌う" (L), as 2 Samuel 22:50 and close to the Japanese of Romans 15:9, which quotes this verse
decisions.reason: The verse is quoted in Romans (m1); Balanced and Readable keep hodah as 感謝する.

source.text: מַגְדִּיל֮ יְשׁוּע֪וֹת מַ֫לְכּ֥וֹ וְעֹ֤שֶׂה חֶ֨סֶד׀לִמְשִׁיח֗וֹ לְדָוִ֥ד וּלְזַרְע֗וֹ עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: making great [the] salvations of his king, and doing loyal love to his anointed, to David and to his offspring forever.

en.L: [He is] making great the salvations of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} king, and showing loyal love to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anointed, to David and to his offspring forever."
en.B: Great are the victories {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} grants {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} king; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} keeps faith in loyal love with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anointed one, with David and his line for all time."
en.R: He makes {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} king win great battles. He always shows faithful love to the king {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} chose, David, and to his children and grandchildren forever."

fr.L: [Il] rend grandes les victoires de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} roi, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} montre l’amour loyal à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} oint, à David et à sa descendance pour toujours. »
fr.B: Grandes sont les victoires qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} accorde à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} roi ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} garde {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle envers {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} oint, envers David et sa lignée, pour tous les temps. »
fr.R: Il fait gagner à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} roi de grandes batailles. Il montre toujours {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle au roi qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a choisi, à David, à ses enfants et à ses petits-enfants, pour toujours. »

sw.L: [Yeye] anaufanya mkuu wokovu wa mfalme {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, na kumtendea upendo usiokoma masihi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, Daudi na uzao wake milele."
sw.B: Ni mkuu ushindi anaompa mfalme {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}; anaonyesha upendo usiokoma kwa yule aliyempaka mafuta, kwa Daudi na uzao wake nyakati zote."
sw.R: Humwezesha mfalme {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kushinda vita vikubwa. Daima huonyesha upendo usiokoma kwa mfalme aliyemchagua, Daudi, na kwa watoto na wajukuu wake milele."

es.L: [Él] engrandece las salvaciones de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rey, y muestra amor leal a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ungido, a David y a su descendencia para siempre».
es.B: Grandes son las victorias que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} da a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rey; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} mantiene {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ungido, con David y su descendencia por todos los tiempos».
es.R: Él hace que {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rey gane grandes batallas. Siempre muestra {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel al rey que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} escogió, David, y a sus hijos y nietos para siempre».

vi.L: [Ngài là Đấng] làm cho những sự cứu rỗi của vua {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nên lớn, và tỏ tình yêu thương thành tín với người được xức dầu của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, với Đa-vít và với dòng dõi người đến đời đời."
vi.B: Ngài ban cho vua của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} những chiến thắng lớn lao; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giữ trọn tình yêu thương thành tín với người được xức dầu của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, với Đa-vít và dòng dõi người đến muôn đời."
vi.R: Ngài cho vua của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thắng những trận lớn. Ngài luôn bày tỏ tình thương không hề thay đổi với vị vua {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chọn, là Đa-vít, và với con cháu người mãi mãi."

ko.L: [그분은] 그분의 왕에게 큰 구원을 베푸시고, 그분의 기름 부음 받은 이, 다윗과 그의 자손에게 영원히 한결같은 사랑을 베푸신다."
ko.B: 그분께서 그분의 왕에게 큰 승리를 안겨 주시고, 그분의 기름 부음 받은 이, 다윗과 그의 자손에게 영원토록 한결같은 사랑으로 신실하게 대하신다."
ko.R: 그분께서는 그분의 왕이 큰 전쟁에서 이기게 하신다. 그분께서 택하신 왕 다윗과 그의 자손에게 영원히 변함없는 사랑을 보여 주신다."

pt.L: [Ele] engrandece as salvações do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} rei, e usa de amor leal para com o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} ungido, para com Davi e a sua descendência para sempre."
pt.B: Grandes são as vitórias que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} concede ao {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} rei; {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} mostra amor leal ao {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} ungido, a Davi e à sua descendência para todo o sempre."
pt.R: Ele faz o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} rei vencer grandes batalhas. Ele sempre mostra amor leal ao rei que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} ungiu, a Davi, e aos seus filhos e netos para sempre."

am.L: የንጉሡን መድኃኒቶች ታላቅ የሚያደርግ፣ ለቀባውም፣ ለዳዊትና ለዘሩ ለዘላለም ጽኑ ፍቅርን የሚያደርግ [ነው]።»
am.B: ለንጉሡ የሚሰጣቸው ድሎች ታላቅ ናቸው፤ ለቀባው ለዳዊትና ለዘሩ ለዘላለም በጽኑ ፍቅር ታማኝነቱን ይጠብቃል።»
am.R: ንጉሡ በታላላቅ ጦርነቶች ድል እንዲያደርግ ያደርጋል። ለቀባው ንጉሥ ለዳዊትና ለልጆቹ፣ ለልጅ ልጆቹም ለዘላለም ጽኑ ፍቅሩን ያሳያል።»

hi.L: [वे] अपने राजा के उद्धारों को महान बनाते [हैं], और अपने अभिषिक्त पर, दाऊद पर और उसके वंश पर सदा अटल प्रेम दिखाते हैं।"
hi.B: वे अपने राजा को बड़ी-बड़ी विजयें देते हैं; वे अपने अभिषिक्त, दाऊद और उसके वंश के प्रति सदा अपने अटल प्रेम में विश्वासयोग्य रहते हैं।"
hi.R: वे अपने राजा को बड़ी-बड़ी लड़ाइयों में जीत दिलाते हैं। वे उस राजा पर, जिसे उन्होंने चुना है, यानी दाऊद पर, और उसकी सन्तान और उनकी सन्तान पर सदा अपना अटल प्रेम दिखाते रहते हैं।"

ru.L: [Он —] дающий великие спасения своему царю и являющий неизменную любовь своему помазаннику, Давиду и его потомству вовеки.»
ru.B: Великие победы {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} дарует своему царю; {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} верно хранит неизменную любовь к своему помазаннику, к Давиду и его роду во все времена.»
ru.R: Он даёт своему царю великие победы. Он всегда проявляет неизменную любовь к царю, которого {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} избрал, — к Давиду и к его детям и внукам навеки.»

ja.L: [その方は]ご自分の王の救いを大いなるものとし、ご自分の油注がれた者に、ダビデとその子孫に、とこしえに誠実を尽くされる。」
ja.B: その方がご自分の王に与えられる勝利は大きい。その方は、ご自分の油注がれた者、ダビデとその子孫に、とこしえに変わらぬいつくしみを示される。」
ja.R: その方は、ご自分の王に、戦いの大きな勝利を与えてくださる。ご自分が油を注いで立てた王ダビデと、その子どもや孫たちに、いつまでも変わらぬいつくしみを示してくださる。」

uk.L: [Він] звеличує спасіння свого царя і виявляє незмінну любов своєму помазанцеві, Давидові та його нащадкам навіки.»
uk.B: Великі перемоги {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} дарує своєму цареві; {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} зберігає незмінну любов до свого помазанця, до Давида та його роду повіки.»
uk.R: Він дає своєму цареві здобувати великі перемоги. Він завжди виявляє вірну любов до царя, якого {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} вибрав, — до Давида, до його дітей і внуків навіки.»

decisions.choice: making great: the word as read, not as written
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text writes this word slightly differently from the form its notes say to read. The words follow the form to be read, "making great". In 2 Samuel 22:51 the matching word can be read as "tower".

decisions.choice: salvations: victories
decisions.reason: The plural of yeshu'ah (13:6) here means acts of rescue, victories in battle.

decisions.choice: his anointed, David and his offspring forever: the promise to David
decisions.reason: The king anointed by God (1 Samuel 16:13) is David, and the song ends with God's promise of a lasting line (2 Samuel 7:12-16). "Anointed" (mashiach) is the word behind "Messiah" and "Christ", and the promise was later understood to point to the Messiah.

decisions.choice: loyal love
decisions.reason: As in 13:6.

decisions.choice: loyal love (B); faithful love (R)
decisions.reason: As in 13:6.

decisions.choice: the king he chose
decisions.reason: Readable says what anointing meant: choosing someone as king.

decisions.choice: amor leal; o rei que ele ungiu (R)
alternatives: amor fiel; o rei que ele escolheu
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 22:51: "amor leal" at every level, where the English Readable says "faithful love", and "o rei que ele ungiu", where it says "chose", so the song ends with the same words in both books.

decisions.choice: "የንጉሡን መድኃኒቶች ታላቅ የሚያደርግ" (making great the salvations of his king) where 2 Samuel 22:51 has "a tower of salvations"; the rest, and the closing », as Samuel
decisions.reason: The two Hebrew words differ by one vowel letter; the psalm reads "making great".

decisions.choice: "उद्धारों को महान बनाते" (L), "बड़ी-बड़ी विजयें देते" (B)
decisions.reason: The Psalm reads "making great the salvations" where 2 Samuel 22:51 reads "a tower of salvations" (the two Hebrew words look alike). The second half keeps the 2 Samuel wording, with "अटल प्रेम" and "अभिषिक्त".

decisions.choice: "дающий великие спасения" (L), "Великие победы ... дарует" (B)
decisions.reason: The Psalm reads "making great the salvations" (m1) where 2 Samuel 22:51 reads "a tower of salvations" ("башня спасений").

decisions.choice: "неизменная любовь" at Readable too
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 22:51 has "верная любовь" at Readable; the poetry note sets "неизменная любовь" for God's hesed at every level in the Psalms (m4).

decisions.choice: "помазанник" (L, B); "царь, которого он избрал" (R)
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 22:51 and 1 Samuel 2:10 in this translation: "помазанник", not "Мессия" (m3); Readable follows the English.

decisions.choice: chesed "誠実" (L), "変わらぬいつくしみ" (B, R; 2 Samuel 22:51 R has 変わらないいつくしみ); meshicho "ご自分の油注がれた者" (L, B), "ご自分が油を注いで立てた王" (R), no christos span
decisions.reason: The Psalter's hesed and anointed-king forms (m3, m4).
